visualCharacteristics.purpose: Blog story header: category links, title, date, byline with share links, then a full-width hero image or video
visualCharacteristics.layout: Text column (max 930px, centered): Role/Topic links in a row, H1, publication date, byline (author name bold + author title) with the share block right-aligned on the same row; hero below spans the full block width

contentPattern.structure: Auto-built on Template = blog-article pages (scripts.js buildAutoBlocks), not authored. Key/value rows Role, Topic, Publication Date, Author, Author Title from page metadata; a row with the first H1; a row with the hero that directly follows the H1 (picture paragraph or Embed (video) block); a row with a nested share block
contentPattern.example: Role 'People and Engagement', Topic 'Life at Blue Shield', Publication Date 2026-03-18, H1 'Perseverance in Motion', hero image
contentPattern.behavior: Category links go to /blog?role=<value> and /blog?topic=<value> (story-listing URL state); date renders as 'March 18, 2026'; byline is omitted when there is no Author; several authors (comma-separated) render as 'A, B and C'; the H1 and hero are moved out of the body (not duplicated); nested share/embed blocks are decorated by this block

reuseGuidance: Do not author. Set page metadata Template = blog-article plus Role, Topic, Publication Date and optionally Author / Author Title; start the body with an H1 followed by the hero image or an Embed (video) block.
